US_force: Preserve the authoritative Branch settlement scale: approximately 10-11 fast carrier decks, CV5 + CVL5-6 class, with about 650-700 embarked aircraft class. Exact hull allocation is not re-opened in this overlay because the Branch US pipeline differs from historical Cabot/Enterprise availability.

prestrike_Japanese_actions.main_fleet: No mass Combined Fleet anchorage is recreated at Palau. Four-carrier core and heavy reserve remain on the southern reaction/fuel axis under the 20-Mar standing order.
prestrike_Japanese_actions.high_value_auxiliaries: Remaining major AO/repair/high-value transport loiter is cut sharply during 28-29 Mar. Ships able to clear safely do so before mining/strike onset; small craft, repair-bound ships and ordinary shipping cannot all escape.
prestrike_Japanese_actions.aircraft: Selected reconnaissance/transport/repair-worthy aircraft and nonessential transients are ferried or dispersed when feasible. The local combat force is not evacuated wholesale because Palau remains a defended forward node.
prestrike_Japanese_actions.base: A-grade integrated warning/plot/AA/fighter readiness is held continuously into 30 Mar; revetment, dispersal, redundant communications and repair teams are activated.

battle_course.30Mar: US strikes meet a prepared local defense. Japanese warning/plot discipline improves first-day exchange and reduces catastrophic surprise, but US numbers, fighter quality, strike repetition and target selection suppress airfields, shipping and sensor/command nodes.
battle_course.31Mar: US attacks increasingly target radar/plot/communications and surviving aviation infrastructure. Japanese local closed loop degrades; second-day defense becomes more fragmented despite prior preparation. Carrier-laid mines still complicate harbor escape and trap lower-value shipping.
battle_course.Japanese_mobile_carrier_intervention: NONE; separate decision file keeps the release gate closed.

settled_results_by_31MarT24.high_value_shipping_effect: Materially less exposed than a mass-anchorage outcome because pre-dispersal is executed; ordinary/small/repair-bound shipping still takes losses and mining friction.
settled_results_by_31MarT24.qualitative: US raid succeeds at temporary base neutralization and air attrition, but fails to catch the Branch Japanese main fleet or its critical mobile logistics concentration.

causal_read: The mature ISR system changes the loss mix, not the existence of the raid. Warning saves mobile assets and improves first-day defense; it cannot overcome TF58 air mass or keep the fixed Palau base intact.
